race.comment: IRK MCGLURK (4) settled handy then found the lead only to be claimed in the straight and finish second last start over 1700m at this track, a step forward after his fifth at Cowra the run before. Meets a comparable field and he can play a big role. NEVERTOOLATE (3) saluted two starts ago at Cowra but was unable to replicate that result at his latest appearance over 1700m at this track, beaten 4.5 metres into third after being up on the pace. Has the benefit of a good draw. Meets a comparable field and he can get the job done. IM HERE TO PARTY (7) comes right into contention after scoring last start by 10 metres at Bathurst over 1730m. IDEAL TAO (2) must be included on the back of some solid recent form, most recently when fourth at this track over 1700m.
